descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使在温哥华吃炙烧寿司后画的菜单，改淡了阴影。
descriptions.en: A Vancouver aburi menu with its pencil shading lightened.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在温哥华尝纳奈莫方块后自画的侧面菜单。
descriptions.en: A side-view menu drawn after a Nanaimo bar in Vancouver.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 温哥华海堤歇步时自画的个人便纸，不是路线指示。
descriptions.en: A personal seawall drawing from Vancouver, made during a pause.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使把温哥华的方块点心画得像书，留下这张原创纸。
descriptions.en: An original Vancouver dessert drawing that resembles stacked books.

names.en: A Little Roof for a Pencil

descriptions.zh-Hans: 看布洛代尔圆顶温室后整理的自画弧线草稿。
descriptions.en: A homemade curve draft after looking at Bloedel Conservatory’s dome.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使把海堤观察加标签后亲手折的纸条，供翻看个人回忆。
descriptions.en: A hand-folded strip with labels for the messenger’s seawall observation.
